The visible oddities (scrambled reference designators, auto‑generated NET00xx labels, DNP 'X' marks on the optional sensors, the LiDAR shown only as a board connector, and the firmware‑vs‑schematic pin mismatch) are either naming/drawing conventions or limitations the specification explicitly documents, and I could not substantiate any behavior‑changing deviation from the drawing alone.
